influences.name: Nils Lofgren
influences.context: He also expressed his appreciation for Nils Lofgren, who was 18 when he joined Young for After the Gold Rush. "I just loved his guitar playing. When we matched up and played dual guitars on 'Tell Me Why,' it's fantastic!"
